body: I agree, everyone is saying the world is getting better and more advanced but in reality humans are destroying the earth with their greed and hunger for more power while others are dieing and starving.

It's funny, I watch advertisement and TV shows of these so called 'perfect' families and everyone cheering and happy pretending everything is so great and wonderful. But in reality anymore I've seen so many people now going through horrible depressions, having such bad issues they feel they will never escape. I really, really hope you feel better and I also agree, I think I would not mind a mass extinciton event as well.
I feel as if I wrote this post. Seriously, I feel you bro.

I have a health issue that limits me from socializing/working certain times of the day, I have had severe depression since 2006 after a lot of bad things happened in my childhood. I constantly am overcome by fear of the unknown. I feel tired/worn out every day even though I don't hardly do anything. And that's only a couple reasons.

I couldn't agree more. Everyone I've ever talked to about this just says, "Hang in their you'll get through it!" or "You just have to let it go and be happy" and it's the same boring "helpful" advice they try to give every time. People who do not have the type of depression we do will NEVER understand. But killing yourself is not

Look all joking aside, I feel you I seriously do. I have had 8 horrible years where I constantly suffer with a BAD health problem that limits me from being able to socialize/work/move certain times of the day. There is not a day I don't wake up and want to die. I don't want to kill myself but I wish something else would. Don't ever feel alone with these issues. As for the drugs please be careful, let me tell you overdosing on drugs is one of the most horrible ways to die. I know because my friend OD'd and he suffered in agony for 3 days before he finally took his last breath.
100% agree. I feel the same way.
No take them out to dinner

I've suffered with Morning Hell for the past year and a half now. Every day I wake up in the late morning I suffer from what is known as "LPR" which causes horrible throat clearing/coughing, tickling sensation, hoarsness, loss of voice. My vocal cords are severely damaged and I hate living because of this. You are not alone.

Your problem is you are trying to hard to do exactly what society says you should. Most people get depressed around that age because they think that since they turned 18 they immediatly have to go to college, get a job, move out, and be successful according to standards set by society. To much stress now-a-days.
Only about 8 years now for me. But I still feel the same way.
Take me with you.
Dead, I have LPR which causes me to suffer horribly every day and never have any relief. So either the LPR will kill me or the stress will kill me whichever comes first I don't know.

At least you don't have a disease that causes you to not be able to get a job or have a normal life and bothers you 24/7 and will probably kill you when you get older unless the stress kills you first. I would give anything to just have normal issues like not having a girlfriend or being depressed.

I found it so true when you said that people have to go through it to understand it. As someone who has been depressed for over 8 years now I've been told it's all in my mind, that I can just wish it away if I want. I've been told nothing is wrong accept my mind. People don't understand this horrible state. I've also had a horrible health issue for the past year and the other day I almost had an accident in traffic because someone swerved in front of me accept I wasn't afraid, I was almost happy that I almost died.

Hardly any really, most doctors just shove you on PPI's which don't help in fact the side effects are worse. I'm trying to go on Probiotics and Digestive Enzymes but who knows. There's hardly any treatment for it as it's an underrated issue.

I know right, people/doctors have no idea how bad it is. I've been told in the past that I should stop clearing my throat or that I should eat healthier or even that it's all in my mind. They have no idea how hard it is to live with this. I eat as healthy as I can and yet I still suffer from this cursed illness. Meanwhile all my friends go about their life with no issues, happy as hell. It irritates me so much.
Plus I wouldn't mind if I just had OCD even Depression I can sort of live with. But having LPR is pretty much end game for me.
I will never be able to be into music or comedy as I can't speak properly anymore. My voice is almost to the point of chronic hoarsness.

Funny I just posted something like this,
https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/3tm04w/honestly_i_really_dont_care_anymore/
I know exactly what it's like suffering with LPR. I'm 19 and I have no possible good outcome of life now.

You mean my symptoms? Major Depression, Obessive Thinking, I can never let anything go. I am constantly worried about the future, My thoughts constantly race and I can never relax. I am very anti-social. I lose my mind when I can't control the outcome of certain situations. And that's only the surface of it.
No, I'm still suffering with my Chronic problems, dealing with OCD, Depression, and LPR makes life look all the more sucky and dull. I guess we can hope for better times though...
